📰 Detecting AI Writing: Perplexity & Burstiness

AI-generated text exhibits statistical fingerprints—low perplexity and uniform burstiness—that differ from human writing. Detection tools leverage these signals, but improving models constantly challenge static heuristics, requiring adaptive, human-in-the-loop systems.
